title: Human CD8 T Cell Transduction and Rapid Expansion Protocol
author: Kristin Anderson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sxvefn6

steps.title: Prepare 293T packaging cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend 3 × 10⁶ 293T cells in 10 mL LCL medium, plate in a 10 cm dish, and incubate at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Transfect 293T cells with DNA
steps.instruction: Transfect the 293T cells using Effectene as follows:

substeps.instruction: Thaw DNA tubes and prepare one 5 mL polypropylene tube per plate.
Add 280.7 µL EC Buffer to each tube.
Add 2.5 µg M‑Mix (2.6 µL) and 1.5 µg DNA to the EC Buffer; mix.
Add 32 µL Enhancer, vortex 1 s, incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Add 60 µL Effectene, vortex 10 s, incubate 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate existing media from the 293T plates and add 7 mL CTL medium to each plate.
Add 3 mL CTL medium to each Effectene mixture tube, mix by pipetting, then add the mixture dropwise to the corresponding 293T plate.
Swirl gently, return plates to a 37 °C incubator and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Replace media post‑transfection
steps.instruction: Aspirate the spent media from each dish, add 10 mL fresh CTL medium, and incubate at 37 °C.

steps.title: Collect and filter viral supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the viral supernatant from the 293T plates and filter it through a 0.45 µm Thermo Scientific Nalgene syringe filter (cat #190‑9945).

steps.title: Add fresh CTL media to virus plates
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL fresh CTL medium to each plate containing the filtered virus and return to a 37 °C incubator (or use frozen viral supernatant instead).

steps.title: Thaw and count CD8+ T cells
steps.instruction: Quickly thaw CD8⁺ T cells in a 37 °C water bath, perform a dropwise (slow) dilution, and count viable cells.

steps.title: Activate T cells with CD3/CD28 beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend 2 × 10⁷ CD8⁺ T cells with 2 × 10⁷ anti‑CD3/CD28 Dynabeads (1:1 ratio, Dynabeads cat #111.41D, starting concentration 1 × 10⁸ beads/mL).

steps.title: Wash Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Wash the Dynabeads by adding 10 mL CTL medium, mixing, and removing the supernatant.

steps.title: Dilute cells and add IL‑2
steps.instruction: Dilute the bead‑bound T cells to 5 × 10⁶ cells/mL with CTL medium, add IL‑2 to a final concentration of 50 U/mL, and transfer the suspension into T25 flasks.

steps.title: Incubate activated T cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the flasks at 37 °C for approximately 4 hours.

steps.title: Spin down and recount T cells
steps.instruction: Spin the cells at 369 × g for 4–5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 10 mL CTL medium, and recount viable cells.

steps.title: Aliquot cells for transduction
steps.instruction: Aliquot the cells into 15 mL tubes (one tube per transduction condition) and spin at 369 × g for 4–5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: First transduction with viral supernatant
steps.instruction: Resuspend each cell pellet in viral supernatant, add IL‑2 to 50 U/mL and Polybrene to 5 µg/mL, and dispense 2 mL into each well of a 12‑well plate.

steps.title: Spinoculation and overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Spin the 12‑well plates at 1 265 × g, 30 °C for 90 min (spinoculation), then place plates in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator overnight.

steps.title: Second transduction repeat
steps.instruction: Combine all cells, spin at 369 × g for 4–5 min at 4 °C, resuspend in fresh viral supernatant with 50 U/mL IL‑2 and 5 µg/mL Polybrene, add 2 mL per well to a 12‑well plate, spin at 1 265 × g, 30 °C for 90 min, and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Add fresh CTL with 100 U/mL IL‑2
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL fresh CTL medium containing 100 U/mL IL‑2 to each well.

steps.title: Remove Dynabeads from culture
steps.instruction: Remove Dynabeads as follows:

substeps.instruction: Combine all cells in a 15 mL tube and spin at 369 × g for 4–5 min at 4 °C.
Rinse each well with 5 mL CTL medium, resuspend cells, and mix to break clumps.
Place the tube on a magnetic separator for ~2 min to collect beads on the side.
Carefully pipette off the cell‑containing supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Wash the bead pellet once with 5 mL CTL medium, then repeat magnetic separation.
Spin the collected cells at 369 × g for 4–5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend the final cell pellet in 8 mL fresh CTL medium containing a 1:1000 dilution of IL‑2 and transfer to one well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Partial media change with 100 U/mL IL‑2
steps.instruction: Perform a half‑media change without disturbing adherent cells:

substeps.instruction: Remove approximately 50 % of the CTL medium from the well without disturbing the cell layer.
Add fresh CTL medium supplemented with 100 U/mL IL‑2 to restore the original volume.

steps.title: Prepare REP mix components
steps.instruction: Prepare the Rapid Expansion Protocol (REP) mix:

substeps.instruction: Thaw mixed donor PBMC, count cells, and irradiate at 4 000 rad.
Count LCL cells and irradiate at 8 000 rad.
Combine the appropriate amounts of irradiated PBMC, irradiated LCL cells, and the activated CD8⁺ T cells according to the desired REP ratio, then place the mixture in a 37 °C incubator.

steps.title: Bi‑daily IL‑2 supplementation to 50 U/mL
steps.instruction: Every 2 days until day 10‑14, replenish IL‑2:

substeps.instruction: Gently pipette off 50‑75 % of the culture medium without disturbing the cells.
Add fresh CTL medium to achieve a final IL‑2 concentration of 50 U/mL.
